key.name: control-values
key.description: Flat dictionary mapping a "<serial>\x1f<control-name>" composite key to its last known integer value, where \x1f is the ASCII Unit Separator. Used to restore camera state on the next launch.

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Controls whether the app follows the system light/dark preference ("default") or forces "light" or "dark". Applied at startup and whenever changed from the primary menu via AdwStyleManager (T-215).

key.name: zoom-lock
key.summary: Hold the zoom where the user set it
key.description:
When true, the zoom slider stops writing and a watchdog puts the pinned value back whenever the device drifts away from it (T-223).
Stored as one application-wide boolean rather than inside the per-camera control-values map (T-228). That map is keyed by USB serial, and the Tiny 2 Lite reports iSerial = 0, so nothing keyed by serial persists on it at all (see PROTOCOL.md section 5). A boolean does not need to distinguish cameras for the single-camera setup this application supports.

key.name: preview-default-on
key.summary: Start the live preview on page open
key.description: When true, the live preview pipeline starts automatically each time the user opens a camera's controls page. When false (default), the user has to flip the preview toggle on per session. Only consulted when the application was built with the `live-preview` Cargo feature (T-200).
